phase_order.entry_condition: controllers receive commands through the real interface with wheels off ground or dyno-equivalent load
phase_order.exit_condition: estop, manual takeover, command logging, timing, and rollback checks pass

phase_order.entry_condition: bench_hil exit condition is met and vehicle remains manually driven
phase_order.exit_condition: shadow commands remain within speed, steering, braking, and geofence limits

phase_order.entry_condition: shadow phase is reviewed and a safety driver is present with physical and remote estop
phase_order.exit_condition: limited-speed maneuvers complete without geofence, takeover, timing, or monitor violations

notes: This plan starts hardware and closed-course validation only; it does not authorize public-road testing.
The AV stack remains a research prototype until independent safety approval, HIL/VIL evidence, and deployment controls are complete.
Model outputs must first run in shadow mode before any steering, throttle, or brake actuation.
